HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE NUPUR BHATI Judgment 12/09/2024 1.

The appellant-claimant has preferred this appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act being aggrieved of the judgment-cum-award dated 16.06.2014 passed by the learned Judge, MACT,
Bhilwara, in MAC No.549/2013 (712/2008) titled "Beni Taraiel Chako Vs. Mangi Lal and Ors."

1 registration No.RJ-20-SB-1630 then, a Mahindra Jeep bearing No.RJ06-UA-0528 driven by the respondent No.2, hit the appellant, whereby he sustained various injuries.

In the said accident, the handle of the motorcycle inserted into the stomach of the appellant resulting in severe injury in his stomach including that of 2 inches hole in intestine (a black mole on back at lumber region).
3.
On account of the injuries sustained by the appellant, he claimed a compensation of Rs.11,50,000/- due to the injuries sustained by him.
The learned Tribunal after hearing the parties awarded a sum of Rs.80,863/- along with interest 6% per annum.
4. Thus being aggrieved of the meager amount of compensation, the appellant-claimant has preferred this appeal seeking enhancement of the award passed by the learned Tribunal.
5. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant has received seven injuries which are simple in nature and the amount awarded by the learned Tribunal is on the lower side.
6. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondents submits that the amount awarded by the learned Tribunal is true and correct and does not deserve to be modified.
7. I have heard and considered the submissions advanced at bar and have gone through the impugned award and the original record.

8. Taking into consideration that the appellant-claimant has suffered seven simple injuries and in view of guidelines laid down by the Rajasthan State Legal Services Authority for Settlement of MACT Cases in Lok Adalats dated 07.09.2024, the amount of [2024:RJ-JD:37999] (3 of 3)
[CMA-1510/2014] compensation towards the simple injuries suffered by the claimant should be Rs.3500/- x 7 i.e. Rs.24,500/-, in addition to the award passed by the learned Tribunal.

Hence, the award stands modified to Rs. 80,863+24,500/-= Rs.1,05,363.
9.
Thus, the present misc. appeal is partly allowed and the appellant-claimant is entitled to get enhanced compensation of Rs.24,500/-.
The judgment-cum-award dated 16.06.2014 passed by the learned Judge, MACT, Bhilwara, in MAC No.549/2013 (712/2008), is modified accordingly.

The respondents/non- claimants are directed to pay the said amount along with the interest @ 6% from the date of filing of claim petition to the appellant within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this judgment, failing which the claimant shall be entitled to get interest @ 7.5% p.a. on the enhanced amount.
10. No order as to costs.

(DR. NUPUR BHATI),J 30-ajayS/-
